snippet.title: Spirimonz : Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Here’s a sneak peek at “Spirimonz” in-game.

Spirimonz is a game where you hunt Dark Spirits and capture various ghostly companions who will help you and follow you on every new mission.

In an atmosphere that’s part horror, part cartoon, explore various haunted locations, discover what kind of Dark Spirits dwell there, and free them before they turn on you... 

The game will be released this summer on Steam, Playstore and Apple Store
